items.exampleEn: I want a hamburger and a coke.
items.exampleZh: 我要一個漢堡和一杯可樂。

items.exampleEn: Kids love ice cream in summer.
items.exampleZh: 小孩夏天都愛吃冰淇淋。

items.exampleEn: Please wash your cup after lunch.
What do you want for dinner?

items.sentenceEn: We have fish for dinner tonight.

items.audioEn: I don't want a hamburger. I want some ice cream.
items.audioZh: 我不想吃漢堡，我想吃冰淇淋。

items.sentenceEn: Can I have a cup of coffee?

items.passageEn: On Friday night, my family eats dinner at a fish restaurant. My father has fish, and my mother has chicken. I have a hamburger because I don't like fish. After dinner, we walk to the beach and eat ice cream. My little sister drinks only water.
items.passageZh: 星期五晚上，我們全家在一家魚料理餐廳吃晚餐。我爸爸吃魚，我媽媽吃雞肉。我吃漢堡，因為我不喜歡吃魚。晚餐後，我們走到海邊吃冰淇淋。我妹妹只喝水。

referenceEn: I want to eat fish for dinner.
rubricZh: 「晚餐吃⋯」可用 for dinner（例如 fish for dinner）
fish 當食物時通常不加 a、不加 s

items.instructionZh: 用 eat 造一個句子，說說你常吃的一種食物。
referenceEn: I often eat fish for dinner.
rubricZh: eat 後面直接接食物（例如 eat rice）
習慣性的事用現在簡單式（例如 I eat、I often eat）
